items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And Joe says, "I've got a job for you with Fred Astaire, but I'm not going to give it to you unless you sign with this office."

ctx.x: So we were doing the Fred Astaire Show, and I was the most surprised guy. But it just happened. See, you've got to watch these things, because there are so many turns and things in it. And I never talked a lot about these things, but I figure it's good now, because I don't have to worry one way or the other, you know. I like to get it out. We're in there, so Dave tells me, says, "I want you to go somewhere with me after the session." I said okay. I think we'd just made an album called Swinging Around the World…
